transcript.speaker: Architectural Shift
transcript.text: A distant rumble echoes through the plaster. In the antechamber, the IX on the wall dissolves into VIII.

transcript.speaker: Architectural Shift
transcript.text: The wood paneling grinds shut behind you. The numeral VIII on the antechamber wall is replaced by VII.

transcript.speaker: Architectural Shift
transcript.text: The dripping overhead slows to a halt. The numeral on the wall shifts to VI, and the quiet corridor to the green armchair opens.

transcript.speaker: The Final Toll
transcript.text: All Roman numerals on the antechamber wall extinguish at once. The massive doors to the Judgment Hall grind open.

transcript.speaker: Clinical Intake
transcript.text: Orderlies file the father's papers into iron drawers. His cries fade behind soundproof doors.

transcript.speaker: Hidden Memory
transcript.text: Case #104 names the infant the delayed father never got to hold: Clara. Somewhere deeper in the Shifting Space, a child waits at the edge of the dark.

transcript.speaker: Hidden Archive
transcript.text: The flickering 35mm footage burns itself into your clinical ledger: Case File #000 was authored in your own hand.
